title: Adopt the validated Franky damping route in Release
goal: Replace Release's old Franky/libfranka Cartesian control route with the verified 9931a64 damping route, including its compatible install requirement, configuration, focused tests, and operator documentation.
doneWhen: Release contains the 9931a64 Cartesian damping implementation and validated Franka/Pico configuration without joint-IK or the superseded old Cartesian tracker route.
Release installation requirements install the verified Franky 2.0.0 and libfranka 0.21.2 compatibility route from its public package source, without archiving its wheel.
Focused no-hardware tests and import/config checks pass, and the required operator-only true-hardware revalidation is documented.
No Desk safety limit, collision behavior, or control parameter is increased beyond the validated configuration.
decisions: Release adopts the verified route from RLinf commit 9931a64, whose damping control relies on Franky 2.x and libfranka 0.21.2.
The supported package version is installed from its public package source; no Franky/libfranka wheel is added to Release/resources.
The validated coupled configuration is rotational_stiffness=40.0, rotational_damping=4.0, and rotational clips=0.15; no joint-IK route is included.

verification.summary: Release commit e1eb68a adopts the 9931a64 Franky 2.0 Cartesian damping route and the continuous Pico trigger gripper route.
checks: Installed Release Franky upgraded to franky-control 2.0.0+libfranka.0.21.2 from the public libfranka-0.21.2 wheel index
Focused continuous gripper real-environment test: 1 passed
Release configuration parse verified damping and continuous-gripper fields
Python compilation and shell syntax checks passed
limitations: No robot, Desk, Pico, camera, or Robotiq hardware was exercised after the Release migration.
The migrated Release must receive an operator-led unloaded, small-range hardware revalidation before it is described as verified on this Release worktree.
